'''Bill Bishop''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Brandon tournament]] on 13 May 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court + bounty hunting (All Wrapped Up)]] and Cloud City gambling + mains, according to Neal Razi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d747">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-15-neal-dredlox-tampa-fl-may-13-2000d747/ neal-dredlox-tampa-fl-may-13-2000], DeckTech (Neal "Dredlox" Razi, 15 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-15-neal-dredlox-tampa-fl-may-13-2000d747/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
